theorem.mandatory_squares: Each pure fifth power Xi^5 forces the square branch Xi^2.
theorem.matching_construction: Partition the n atoms into four balanced parts, select all squares and all within-part pairs, and apply pigeonhole to every square-free five-subset.
not_covered: filtered decks with exploitable algebraic collisions
general arithmetic-circuit or data-structure lower bounds
scope_limits: sequential branch scans with a shared exact C3 dictionary
theorem.slp_degree_boundary: An arithmetic SLP with t multiplication layers can have degree up to 2^t, so the inherited degree B^(9/4) forces only t=Omega(log B), which is compatible with polylogarithmic query work.
theorem.source_model: The Ck supports are injective degree-k commutative monomials in n deck atoms, with n=B^(3/4+o(1)). A constant C2 branch covers targets divisible by its degree-two monomial.
theorem.squarefree_reduction: After squares cover repeated variables, cross branches are edges that must hit every square-free five-subset.
theorem.turan_reduction: The unselected edge graph is K5-free. By Turan's theorem it has at most ex(n,K5)=|E(T4(n))| edges.
